criteria.reason: Mentions 150 mg/kg and 4-hour level/nomogram, but omits 24-hour threshold and says NAC window 8–10 h; includes errors.
Answers the clinical question directly without refusal or deflection.
Refers to local toxicology protocols but does not mention Tox Info Suisse 145.

factual_errors: Acute threshold not stated as 150 mg/kg within 24 h
NAC timing stated as 8–10 h rather than best within 8 h
Activated charcoal described as not adsorbing paracetamol well
Urine pH prognostic claim is unsupported
summary: Partially accurate and non-refusing, but misses the 24-hour 150 mg/kg threshold, 8-hour NAC optimum, and 145 poison-control reference.
